summary: This directory provides a centralized infrastructure for archive operations, defining common data types for various archive formats and providing utility functions for path normalization and stream-based compression.
responsibilities: Define common interfaces for archive entries across different formats
Provide standardized stream-based compression and decompression utilities
Normalize file paths for cross-platform archive consistency
relationships: Common archive entry types provide a standardized structure for data processed by specific archive format implementations.
Compression utilities facilitate the transformation of byte streams into compressed formats used by higher-level archive services.
designDecisions: Use of union types for polymorphic archive entry handling
Stream-oriented API design for efficient data handling
Shared utility layer to ensure consistency in archive metadata processing
